item.title: The case of the 9 bit AES key
item.description:
📝 In MuPDF, only 9 bits of random state affect the actual AES-256 key. The issue is that the higher bits of the state never affect the lower bits. That leaves 25 bits that can affect the output.

item.title: Leak website releases data on DHS employees
Scaling Hierarchical Networks
item.description:
📝 Altogether, our results provide evidence that H-Nets are a foundational architecture that truly aligns with the bitter lesson, learning meaning directly from raw data and significantly improving efficiency and scalability. In the context of language modeling, the idea is to build new learning primitives that allow models to recursively chunk low-level data into higher-level meaning: characters into words, words into phrases, phrases into concepts. Furthermore, the signature characterization of H-Nets is that they hierarchically perform this chunking end-to-end.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cartesia.ai/blog/from-tokens-to-bytes-part-1
